summary: Injakkadan Mathai & Sons is a 1993 Malayalam-language film. The note states it was written by Kaloor Dennis and directed by Anil Babu. It names Suresh Gopi, Jagadish, Innocent and Urvashi as its stars.
one_line: A 1993 Malayalam film written by Kaloor Dennis, directed by Anil Babu, starring Suresh Gopi and Urvashi.
